clips.text: She did. I was right here. It was an excellent please.
clips.script: [formal, indignant for her] She did. I was right here. [punchline, certain] It was an EXCELLENT please.

clips.text: Yes. Right away. Everybody give the dragonfly some room.
clips.script: [instant, serious, taking an order] Yes. Right away. [clearing the area] Everybody give the dragonfly some ROOM.

clips.text: It's the size of a plum. I carried a suitcase through two airports this morning.
clips.script: [strained, out of breath] It's the size of a PLUM. [baffled at himself] I carried a suitcase through two airports this morning.

clips.text: Grace. I couldn't even make it wobble.
clips.script: [flat, laughing at himself] Grace. [punchline] I couldn't even make it WOBBLE.

clips.text: GAH! Grace, I'm holding your hand. That's for me, not for you.
clips.script: [real yelp] GAH! [quiet, amazed at himself] Grace, I'm holding your hand. [punchline, honest] That's for ME, not for you.

clips.text: Mom. That's a boss. You don't just walk up to a boss.
clips.script: [urgent whisper] Mom. That's a BOSS. [earnest] You don't just walk UP to a boss.

clips.text: Nobody does. She's gotten me in an empty room.
clips.script: [dry, weary, fond] Nobody does. [punchline, flat] She's gotten me in an EMPTY room.

clips.text: I have a job. Yes. Does the job come with a pencil?
clips.script: [honored, serious] I have a job. Yes. [hopeful] Does the job come with a pencil?

clips.text: Second best. It's going in the pocket with the zipper.
clips.script: [touched, formal] Second best. [solemn promise] It's going in the pocket with the ZIPPER.

clips.text: The long way. That's all the way around the Square. Twice.
clips.script: [agreeing at once, official] The long way. [working it out, pleased] That's all the way around the Square. [pause] TWICE.
